notes.title: Nightzoid - 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
Nightzoid - 1 Year Anniversary!
   10 August 2024

It's been 1 year since I managed to launch my first game (Nightzoid) on steam, and it was the biggest achievement. I'm sorry for the 5-day delay, but I was on vacation and didn't have access to the computer.

I want to thank you for playing my game, for giving me positive and negative reviews related to bugs or some problems.

To celebrate, I want to announce that I will release a DLC, with new endings, new rooms and new items (in few months).

In the future I will work intensively, because the game will change its engine version, from unity 2021 to unity 6.

Thank you again and stay tuned for the next updates.
